inspection.source_reading: Read Sun & Stockey1992 original PDF text, diagnosis and infructescence/bract/nutlet description; inspected actual Figs1–16, particularly paired cymule4, individually bilobed bract6, opposing bracts11 and longitudinal striae/bifurcate styles15–16.
inspection.anatomy: Six paired cymules carry12 nutlets. Each fruit has2 separate deeply bilobed spiny bracts,24 total. Deep individual sinuses are real silhouette geometry.12 styles each have2 small terminal lobes.60 low raised longitudinal ridges exist on nut surfaces. Stem is a fruiting organ only, without invented parent tree or shoot attachment.
inspection.views: All eight512 frames and sheet plus3 fresh exact-GLB closeups reviewed. Paired fruits and individual bract sinuses resolve across front/side/reverse. Natural overlaps and edge-on leaves do not hide entire required organs. Initial oblique closeups made low ridges look like dots; a camera aligned to the actual nut front clearly reveals5 narrow lengthwise tapered relief ridges. Their0.59–1.07mm exposed spans remain subtle compared with4.5mm nut length; frozen brief contains no minimum exposed fraction or full-nut-length requirement. This is not a failure.
inspection.concept: Concept wrongly showed single fruits and cup-like bracts. Final actually supplies paired cymules and two individually bilobed bracts per nut, not a renamed concept.
